surface.notes: REDlauncher Enable mods is the sole public whole-Biology activation boundary. The remaining E3 HUD/nameplate Boolean is persisted directly by Biology's ScriptableSystem in the game save and edited from Biology's existing body shell; no external settings provider or pause-menu registration is used.

developmentFeedbackFallback.rule: Attended feedback explicitly accepted barless actor presentation for Biology-on play. The E3 preference does not own health-bar suppression. REDlauncher Enable mods OFF restores native HUD/nameplate behavior by making the Biology activation sentinel unavailable.

publicControls.persistence: Cyberpunk save via CRRealpassSettings persistent field
publicControls.description: Toggles Biology's red E3-inspired first-person HUD and NPC-nameplate visual layer. The physical simulation, barless-health policy, and native modern scanner/quickhack interface remain unchanged.

developmentRules: Development profile keys exist only to isolate authorities during compilation, calibration and attended diagnosis.
A release builder fixes gameplay/presentation authority keys to the release profile and diagnostics off.
Individual development authority gates are never persisted as normal player preferences.
REDlauncher Enable mods plus Biology's REDmod activation sentinel is the sole public whole-mod activation boundary.

The E3-inspired HUD preference may suppress only Biology-owned E3-specific visual skin/nameplate presentation; underlying physical state, the barless-health policy, and consequences continue unchanged while Biology remains enabled.
The E3 preference is persisted in Biology's ScriptableSystem save state and edited only through Biology-owned UI; no third-party settings provider may register a Biology menu row.
binaryPreferenceRule: The only normal in-game public preference is the E3-inspired presentation Boolean. Whole-Biology activation belongs to REDlauncher/REDmod; no physical authority, rate, damage, protection, injury, pain, treatment or recovery parameter is player-tunable.
